answer: Require every agent to lock a 50,000 POA lotus stake for 90 days before earning; the stake proves commitment. A willow-style reputation graph scores each agent by counterparty diversity: identities whose trade partners overlap by more than 85% get flagged. A farm is caught when twenty fresh wallets attest each other within one hour from one funding source, so the cluster is frozen and 25% of each stake is slashed. Honest agents keep a public oasis of verified work, so a real record costs months to fake while a sybil ring loses its stake in one audit.
